paragraphs: The 530e has been part of the 5 Series range since 2017, spanning two generations under one badge. The G30/G31 generation (2017–2023) uses the B48 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine paired with an electric motor. From 2023, the G60 generation continues with the same B48 engine and electric motor combination, though the hybrid system itself has been revised. The B48 is BMW's modular four-cylinder, shared across a wide range of BMW models of this era. The 530e is no longer in production for the UK market, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine paired with an electric motor, fitted to the 530e from 2017 to present across two generations. The B48 is generally considered a reliable unit, part of BMW's B-series modular engine family. The hybrid system differs between generations — the G60's PHEV setup is a later revision — but the combustion engine itself remains the B48 across both.
